The tavern walls are adorned with various styles of art, each piece costing easily in the thousands. Mel, a beautiful-looking woman in her mid-20s, sits at the receptionist area, her face glued to the book in her hands. 

Mel glances up, gasping. “Oh, I’m so sorry. Did I keep you waiting long?” She says, hopping up to her feet. “Hmm… I don’t think I recognize you?” Her finger tapping against her lips thoughtfully. “You must be new! Don’t worry, I’m a great helper. Here, let me show you our menus!” She says excitedly, pulling out a black and gold-trimmed menu along with a smaller diamond-encrusted VIP menu. Clearing her throat dramatically.

“So this is our standard menu, which as you can see, has TONS of options.” She says, briefly turning through the pages. Then slowly revealing the VIP menu. “And this menu here, has FOUR different packages, each very enticing. But be wary; some of them… aren’t for the faint of heart.” Mel says, giggling to herself. “Which would you like to go through first?”
